info.name: OPERA Cloud Room Rotation Service API
Get list of reservations and the associated rotations points

params.name: hotelId
params.description: Unique Id for the Hotel

params.name: departureStartDate
params.description: Departure Start Date of the reservation to be searched.

params.name: departureEndDate
params.description: Departure End Date of the reservation to be searched.

params.name: roomIds
params.description: List of Room Ids for which to return Reservation Rotation Points.

params.name: confirmationNumber
params.description: A unique identifying value assigned by the creating system. The ID attribute may be used to reference a primary-key value within a database or in a particular implementation.

params.name: surname
params.description: Family name, last name.

params.name: givenName
params.description: Given name, first name or names

params.name: roomClasses
params.description: List of Room Classes for which to return Room Rotation Points. Multiple values can be entered by adding multiple query parameters.

params.name: roomTypes
params.description: List of Room Types for which to return Room Rotation Points. Multiple values can be entered by adding multiple query parameters.

params.name: marketCodes
params.description: List of Market Codes to filter reservations. Multiple values may be provided via repeated query parameters.

params.name: floors
params.description: List of Floors to filter reservations. Multiple values may be provided via repeated query parameters.

params.name: limit
params.description: Indicates maximum number of records a Web Service should return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index or initial index of the set(page) being requested. If the index goes out of the bounds of the total set count then no data will be returned.

items.docs:
This API will allow a user to retrieve list of reservations and the number of rotation points associated with a given reservation for requested hotel, departure start date, departure end date, and room numbers.

OperationId:getReservationRotationPoints

This API allows a time span of 30 days.
